title: Mechanical Road-Test Fee by Miles Since Issue: Collision and Structural Plan Schedule
content:
**Rate.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the mechanical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty is built on the mechanical road-test fee. The mechanical road-test fee follows the miles driven from the odometer at issue to the odometer recorded at the coverage's most recent concern report:

| Miles driven since issue | Mechanical road-test fee |
|---|---|
| at least the high-use multiple, 2 times, of the plan's mechanical parts miles | the high-use mechanical fee, USD 109.95 |
| at least the plan's mechanical parts miles but under 2 times them | the mid-use mechanical fee, USD 99.95 |
| under the plan's mechanical parts miles | the plan's standard diagnostic fee |

## Schedule by plan

The plan's mechanical parts miles are 12000 under the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and 24000 under the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty.

| Plan | USD 109.95 | USD 99.95 | Plan's standard diagnostic fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | 24000 miles or more | 12000 to 23999 miles | under 12000 miles |
| Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty | 48000 miles or more | 24000 to 47999 miles | under 24000 miles |

## Inputs

- **Odometer at issue:** as recorded on the coverage at issue.
- **Odometer at report:** the odometer recorded on the coverage's most recent concern report, whatever kind of concern it was.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty, odometer at issue 30000)

| Odometer at most recent report | Miles driven | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 41999 | 11999 | the plan's standard diagnostic fee |
| 42000 | 12000 | USD 99.95 |
| 53999 | 23999 | USD 99.95 |
| 54000 | 24000 | USD 109.95 |
